verdict.rationale: Slack markets Slackbot as an AI agent that lets users get answers, updates, and briefings via natural language (e.g., 'Update deals just by asking Slackbot', 'Get fast answers with Claude', Slackbot 'understands you and your workspace'), plus AI-driven summarization/search across integrated content, indicating natural-language operation is a real, documented capability rather than just a developer API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language command accuracy or breadth, concrete examples of command syntax/results, and detail on limitations of the AI agent's natural-language understanding.
